display_information.name: Tico
display_information.description: Tico: your AI COO and connection to your company's AI team.
display_information.long_description: Tico is your AI COO and the single Slack app for your company's bots. DM it, or @Tico in a channel it has been invited to, and the message reaches the bot it is for; the reply comes back in the same thread under that employee's name. Bots also call the hub's connectors/slack.py to read channel history (including threads) and, for the channels an owner or admin lists in Tico, to post an update. Every post is recorded in the company's audit log with the employee that made it.
